guide.infinity_gauntlet.page1:
§5§l   INFINITY
   GAUNTLET§r§0

§8Field guide§r§0

Six stones, one gauntlet, and the power to unmake worlds.

§8Turn the page ▶

guide.infinity_gauntlet.page3:
§5§lFirst steps§r§0
The gauntlet works only in your §loffhand§r§0: press §lF§r§0 with it in hand.

Right-click it in your main hand to open the stone slots.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page4:
§5§lThe six stones§r§0
§lPower, Space, Reality, Mind, Time, Soul.§r§0

Stones can't be crafted yet: take them from the Infinity Gauntlet creative tab or use §l/gauntlet give_stone§r§0.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page5:
§5§lAbility wheel§r§0
Hold §lV§r§0: the wheel opens. Point at a stone, then at an ability, and release V to choose.

Press §lR§r§0 to use it.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page6:
§5§lWheel tips§r§0
Hold R for charged powers: strike, beam, Reality.
§lEsc§r§0 cancels. §lPgUp/PgDn§r§0 switch stones.
A dimmed ability is unavailable: hover it to see why.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page7:
§5§lPower Stone§r§0
§lPower strike§r§0: hold R to charge (purple aura), release to smash for damage and knockback.

§lPlanet Destruction§r§0: full charge, then strike the ground.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page8:
§5§lPlanet Destruction§r§0
The planet shatters into fragments. You and nearby players are thrown into Dead Space.

§lTime Stone + R§r§0 there puts everything back together.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page9:
§5§lSun and Moon§r§0
§lCelestial Destruction§r§0: aim at the sun or moon and hold R for ~3 s. It cracks and falls, the sky turns red, and a 5-minute meteor shower begins.

No sun means eternal night.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page10:
§5§lMeteor Stream§r§0
Lock on the sun or moon, then aim at a patch of ground and release.

For 60 s meteors rain on that circle. You are safe from it.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page11:
§5§lSpace Stone§r§0
§lPortal§r§0: opens a portal ahead for 30 s. Pick Nether, End or Overworld in the submenu.

§lBlink§r§0: teleport where you look, up to 96 blocks.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page12:
§5§lFlight§r§0
Fly freely: WASD, Space up, Shift down, §lCtrl§r§0 boosts.

Above Y=256 the sky darkens; around Y=640 you leave the atmosphere.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page13:
§5§lThe Cosmos§r§0
A real Solar System: the Sun, eight planets and the Moon. Aim at a body to see its name and distance.

§lWarp§r§0: pick it in the wheel, press R. 2.5 s charge, then you land on the lit side.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page14:
§5§lBack home§r§0
Near Earth choose §lReturn to atmosphere§r§0, or just fly down to its surface.

Other worlds are solid: you can't land on them.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page15:
§5§lReality Stone§r§0
§lReality strike§r§0: tap R. A red wave turns nearby mobs into butterflies (no drops) and the ground into redstone and fire.

This change is real.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page16:
§5§lReality Inversion§r§0
Hold R: the world cracks, folds and turns inside out around your gaze. Turn your head to steer the rift.

It only changes your view. Release and everything returns. You can't walk while holding.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page17:
§5§lTime Stone§r§0
§lRewind§r§0: you are played back along your last 5 seconds, health and hunger included.

§lDay / Night§r§0: spins the sky to the other half of the day (Overworld only, 30 s cooldown).
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page18:
§5§lMind Stone§r§0
§lGrab§r§0: on terrain it rips out a chunk of real blocks; on a mob it lifts the mob (not bosses). Move your gaze to steer.

Press R again to §lthrow§r§0.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page19:
§5§lMind Stone§r§0
A thrown cluster hits everything around and crumbles into falling blocks.

§lTear apart§r§0: a held mob shakes, turns red and bursts. Loot and XP drop.

§lRelease§r§0 sets it down safely.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page20:
§5§lSoul Stone§r§0
§lExtract soul§r§0: aim at a mob. Its soul is pulled out and absorbed.

Each soul gives §l+1 ❤§r§0 max health and §l+0.5§r§0 damage for 60 s, up to 20 stacks.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page21:
§5§lMass extraction§r§0
A wave pulls the souls of every enemy within 24 blocks. Cooldown 45 s.

Bosses, peaceful mobs and named mobs are safe. On players it drains up to 2 hearts.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page22:
§5§lInfinity Beam§r§0
Needs §lall six stones§r§0. Hold R: 2 s charge, then a 6 s beam of 72 blocks.

It drills a 9-block tunnel (bedrock stays) and takes 70% of the Ender Dragon's health. Cooldown 45 s.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page23:
§5§lInfinity Snap§r§0
Also needs all six stones. The universe is erased: everyone lands in the white void and the gauntlet burns out.

To undo it, right-click a loose §lTime Stone§r§0 there.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page24:
§5§lUru ore§r§0
Uru is a rare metal in the Overworld, from the bedrock up to Y=0, richest near §lY=-32§r§0. Rarer than diamonds; the ore glows faintly.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page25:
§5§lMining and smelting§r§0
Mine it with a §ldiamond or netherite pickaxe§r§0. Fortune works; Silk Touch keeps the ore.

Smelt the ore or §lraw uru§r§0 in a furnace or blast furnace into §lUru ingots§r§0.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page26:
§5§lArmor of Uru§r§0
Craft it like iron armor, from Uru ingots: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots.

Fireproof, tougher than netherite (24 armor points). Repair with ingots on an anvil.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page27:
§5§lAgainst the gauntlet§r§0
A full six-stone gauntlet ignores normal armor and shields. A complete Uru set lets through only 25% of such a hit; instant kills become survivable.

World events are not blocked.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page28:
§5§lInfinity Extractor§r§0
Takes a stone from someone's gauntlet. Hold right-click on a target within 16 blocks and in sight.

Three 3-second cycles pull the stone out. Progress is kept for 20 s.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page29:
§5§lExtractor tips§r§0
Shift + right-click on nothing picks which stone to pull. A stone in use can't be taken.

Shift + right-click with a stone inside takes it out; right-click on nothing returns it to your gauntlet.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page30:
§5§lSettings§r§0
§lLanguage§r§0: Options or Pause menu, button §lInfinity Gauntlet§r§0 (bottom left). Auto, English or Русский.

All keys can be rebound in Controls.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.page31:
§5§lGood to know§r§0
Lost this book? Type §l/gauntlet_guide§r§0.

Operators have §l/gauntlet§r§0 for testing: stones, effects, dummies.

§8Use the power wisely, wielder.
